data.narrative:
Atalana operates in the AI & Software sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (Palantir Technologies, PLTR) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI, representing the frontier-tech subsector.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. While 16 same-sector peers exist in AI & Software, rigorous stage and tier filtering yielded fewer than three datapoints meeting narrow comparability criteria. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of AI & Software valuations across early, growth, and late-stage companies. The sparse filtered set reflects the specialized nature of frontier-tech infrastructure and the wide dispersion of valuation multiples at different maturity levels within the sector.

Given the absence of a sufficient matched-peer cohort, this analysis cannot derive a triangulated valuation range with confidence. A credible valuation would require either: (1) expansion of stage or sector filters to capture at least three valid comparables; (2) bottom-up modeling of revenue, margin, and TAM assumptions; or (3) transaction data from recent funding rounds. The key uncertainty remains the target's current growth profile and capital efficiency relative to the heterogeneous private peer set.
